name: cr606_3_cauldron_creature_has_grists_loyalty_abilities
why: CR 604.3, 606.3, 613.1f: Grist in exile is a creature card, so the Cauldron's counter comes and its loyalty abilities go on the creature, which can pay +1 by putting a loyalty counter on itself and can't pay -2. It activates one once a turn at sorcery timing.
